mapper.select: select r.id, r.registration_no as registrationNo, r.season_id as seasonId, r.member_id as memberId, r.player_id as playerId, r.platform, r.display_game_id as displayGameId, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.submitted_time as submittedTime, r.audit_time as auditTime, pp.game_nickname as playerNickname, s.season_name as seasonName from basket_tournament_open_registration r inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = r.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile pp on pp.id = r.player_id and pp.is_delete = 0 where r.is_delete = 0 and r.registration_no like concat('%', #{registrationNo}, '%') and r.season_id = #{seasonId} and r.registration_status = #{registrationStatus} order by r.submitted_time desc, r.create_time desc

select r.id, r.registration_no as registrationNo, r.season_id as seasonId, r.member_id as memberId, r.player_id as playerId, r.platform, r.display_game_id as displayGameId, r.normalized_game_id as normalizedGameId, r.position_code as positionCode, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.submitted_time as submittedTime, r.audit_time as auditTime, r.remark, r.result_roster_id as resultRosterId, pp.game_nickname as playerNickname, pp.player_no as playerNo, s.season_name as seasonName from basket_tournament_open_registration r inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = r.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile pp on pp.id = r.player_id and pp.is_delete = 0 where r.id = #{id} and r.is_delete = 0
select * from basket_tournament_open_registration where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_tournament_open_registration set registration_status = #{toStatus}, current_auditor_id = #{currentAuditorId}, remark = #{remark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, result_roster_id = #{resultRosterId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and registration_status in #{s} and (current_auditor_id is null or current_auditor_id = #{auditorId})
